text:
ITEM 1 | Two long, flattened fillets with silvery-grey skin showing blue-green iridescence and pale translucent edges, overlapping in a diagonal stack on the plate; footprint roughly 40% of the plate, about 15 cm long and 5 cm wide per fillet, moist with a slight sheen, flesh appears firm and layered, with a thin cooked surface and some browning at the edges, sitting on top of red pepper strips | 210
ITEM 2 | Small tan-to-golden granular grains (similar to cooked lentils or small grain), scattered and clustered over and between the fillets, each grain about 0.3 to 0.5 cm, matte, slightly moist, mostly separate and loose, covering roughly 20% of the plate's food area | 45
ITEM 3 | Thin, pale off-white translucent flakes or slivers, irregular shape about 1 to 2 cm, slightly curled, dry-looking with a fibrous edge, scattered across the top of the fillets | 12
ITEM 4 | Bright green leafy pieces, crinkled and wilted, a few small fragments tucked under and between the fillets plus one larger leaf about 6 cm long at the lower right edge of the plate, moist with a slight sheen | 15
ITEM 5 | Thin red pepper strips, glossy and soft, partly hidden under the fish at the lower left of the fillets, each strip about 4 to 6 cm long and 0.5 cm wide | 8
